segments.expected: It was true. It had been true since the Lane, when she had sat on the fourth tier with Pike and watched the girl lose an exchange on purpose and thought mine in her own head, and known it for what it was. She had been an officer for eleven years. She knew what it looked like when an officer started to keep a girl. It looked like a seat that was never quite offered, and a card that was always renewed, and a van that the girl could never quite leave, because there was always one more night. The officer was always good to her, and it was always kind.
